data.name: Conflict
data.value: The history revision is stale or a competing writer committed. Start a new session or explicitly recover the snapshot; do not replay tools automatically.

data.name: Partial
data.value: The history operation did not complete. Earlier batches remain committed; inspect the last committed reference and count. No rollback across batches or containers is provided.

data.name: MissingHead
data.value: The history metadata is missing for an existing snapshot. It cannot be reset to revision zero.

data.name: BatchFailed
data.value: The conditional history batch failed. Transactional batches and ETag conditions are required, including on the emulator; no sequential fallback is supported.

data.name: TooLarge
data.value: A history message exceeds the safe transactional batch payload budget. Reduce the message size before retrying.

data.name: BatchLimit
data.value: The batch limit must be between 2 and 100, including the reserved history metadata operation.

data.name: PositiveLimit
data.value: The message/query limit must be positive.
